column1: # EXCLUDED.jvm.tsv -- tests/snobol4 (the SNOBOL4 rungs master): the entries that leave snobol4jvm's denominator ALONE, read by util_score_row.py only for a key @jvm
# (R-1864 (4); harness of 2026-11-17 reads a master's engine list). SCRIP's rows and the dotnet engine's never read it. Class NO_CASE_FOLDING_BY_LON (Lon
# 2026-11-17 18:2x CST, in the JVM window, verbatim: "We WILL NEVER support case-folding."): an entry whose sbl -bf answer turns on the folding &CASE = 1 turns on.
# Class SNOBOL4PP_EXTENSION_KEPT_BY_LON (Lon 2026-11-17 18:1x CST, in the JVM window: "let's do more of a SNOBOL4++ where it has all extensions and keeps the dynamic
# power of SNOBOL4"): an entry whose sbl -bf answer turns on a SPITBOL restriction snobol4jvm lifts; its SPITBOL ref stands.

column3: sets &CASE = 1, after which sbl -bf folds the lower case names EVAL and CODE read; snobol4jvm never folds case (Lon 2026-11-17 18:2x CST, measured on 1e740ad)

sbl -bf ends line 20, DEFINE('ITEM()'), with ERROR 248 (attempted redefinition of system function); CSNOBOL4 -b and snobol4jvm ccbd25c let a DEFINE replace a system function, and both then end at line 28, statement 9, an undefined function (CSNOBOL4 Error 5, the port 022)

sbl -bf answers 156 (opsyn first arg is not correct operator name) for OPSYN('STRLEN','SIZE',1), OPSYN('SUM','+',2), OPSYN('+','SIZE',2) and OPSYN('&','SIZE',1); CSNOBOL4 (snobol4 -b) accepts all four, and snobol4jvm accepts them and answers every other line as sbl does, 152 and 153 included (measured 2026-11-18 on 0912956)
